verdict.rationale: Moss is a search runtime, so data replication for high availability is an applicable axis. The evidence never documents replication across nodes or zones, nor any consistency model. What it does show is a client-side cloud-to-device pattern: local indexes sync to the cloud, devices hydrate from the cloud with hot-swaps, and a cached snapshot is served if the cloud is unreachable. That is offline resilience and caching, not server-side HA replication with stated consistency guarantees.
